Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy Market Companion
Description: Keep an Auto-Market list of items you always sell. The companion lists them through your retainers in the stack size you choose (keeping a reserve in your bags if you want), prices every listing by matching the lowest board price instead of undercutting, and can do all of it inside AutoRetainer's venture cycle. Also re-prices existing listings (Auto Pinch). Successor to Dagobert Price Matcher; your old settings are imported automatically.
Punchline: Auto-lists your always-sell items and matches market board prices

v0.2.8.22 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- **Mannequin detection no longer skips every real listing on German, French and Japanese clients.** The check compared the context menu against the price window title text (Addon sheet row 930) instead of the menu's own Adjust Price action text (row 959). On English clients the two read the same, but on German, French and Japanese clients they differ, so each real listing looked like a mannequin and was skipped. The check now reads the menu action text (the fix is ported from upstream Dagobert's Auto Pinch).
